scope: Released-SDK baseline for the WW26 profitability dual-axis Pareto case.
supported: add_calculated_field(..., table_calc={'ordering_type': 'Field', 'ordering_field': '[Order ID]'}) for the RUNNING_SUM/WINDOW_SUM/WINDOW_MAX/LOOKUP chain
configure_layered_chart(axis_shelf='rows', fold_axes=True, synchronized=False) for the unsynchronised folded dual axis
sort_mode='computed' with sort_field='Order ID' and sort_descending='SUM(Profit)' for the profit-descending order list
a Line pane coloured by a boolean field over a Bar pane
set_worksheet_rich_title referencing the two window-max measures

findings.summary: Passing table_calc_overrides for these fields replaces the auto-generated nested <table-calc> dependency metadata (the field="[ds].[Calculation_...]" entries). Without it the cumulative curve collapses to 100% and the subtitle reads 397100% / 0%.
findings.workaround: Leave table_calc_overrides unset; the builder then emits the correct nested metadata from the field-level table_calc declarations.
